name: Footwork - Toes (Pilates V)
description: Heels together, toes apart on the footbar in Pilates V. Press the carriage out and return with control.

name: Footwork - Arches
description: Arches of the feet on the footbar, toes wrapped. Press out and return with control.

name: Footwork - Heels
description: Heels on the footbar, feet flexed. Press out and return with control.

name: Footwork - Tendon Stretch
description: Legs straight, balls of feet on the footbar. Lower the heels under the bar and rise up.

name: The Hundred
description: Holding the straps, curl the head and chest up, legs extended, pump the arms breathing in for 5 and out for 5.

name: Overhead
description: Holding the straps, roll the legs over the head, open the legs and roll down with control.

name: Coordination
description: Curl up, extend arms and legs, open and close the legs, bend the knees, then lower the arms.

name: Rowing - Into the Sternum
description: Seated facing the straps, hands at the sternum. Round forward, reach the arms up and circle them down.

name: Rowing - 90 Degrees
description: Seated facing the straps, arms at 90 degrees. Round back, flatten, stretch forward and circle the arms.

name: Rowing - From the Chest
description: Seated with back to the straps, hands at the chest. Press the arms forward, stretch down over the legs and circle the arms up.

name: Rowing - From the Hips
description: Seated with back to the straps, hands by the hips. Lift the arms forward, stretch over the legs and circle the arms up.

name: Rowing - Shaving
description: Seated on the box, hands behind the head holding the straps. Extend the arms up on a diagonal and bend back.

name: Rowing - Hug a Tree
description: Seated on the box, arms open to the sides. Bring the arms together in front as if hugging a tree.

name: Swan on the Long Box
description: Prone on the long box, hands on the footbar. Push the carriage away while lifting the chest into extension.

name: Pulling Straps
description: Prone on the long box. Pull the straps back to the hips while lifting the chest. Second part: arms open into a T.

name: Backstroke
description: Supine on the long box, curled up. Reach arms and legs to the ceiling, open them out, circle the arms down.

name: Teaser on the Long Box
description: In Teaser position on the long box holding the straps. Lift and lower the arms while holding the Teaser.

name: Horseback
description: Straddling the long box holding the straps. Round the back and lift the body off the box.

name: Short Box - Round Back
description: Seated on the short box, feet under the strap. Roll back in a C-curve and return.

name: Short Box - Flat Back
description: Arms overhead, hinge back with a flat back and return.

name: Short Box - Side to Side
description: Arms overhead, bend to one side and the other, keeping the hips square.

name: Short Box - Twist
description: Twist, reach forward on the diagonal, roll back and return. Alternate sides.

name: Short Box - Tree
description: One leg up, walk the hands up the leg, roll back and climb back up.

name: Short Spine Massage
description: Feet in the straps, roll the legs overhead, bend the knees and roll down through the spine.

name: Long Stretch
description: Plank with hands on the footbar and feet against the shoulder rests. Move the carriage out and in holding the plank.

name: Down Stretch
description: Kneeling with feet against the shoulder rests, chest lifted. Push the carriage back and pull in.

name: Up Stretch
description: From a pike, lower into plank and push back up to the pike.

name: Elephant
description: Hands on the footbar, heels against the shoulder rests, body in a pike. Move the carriage out and in from the abdominals.

name: Long Back Stretch
description: Hands on the footbar behind you. Dip down, push the carriage out, lift up and return.

name: Stomach Massage - Round
description: Seated, toes on the footbar, back rounded. Press out, lift the heels, and return.

name: Stomach Massage - Hands Back
description: Hands behind on the carriage, spine lifted. Press out and return.

name: Stomach Massage - Reach Up
description: Arms reaching up, spine lifted. Press out and return.

name: Stomach Massage - Twist
description: Twist toward one side holding the frame. Press out and in, then change sides.

name: Tendon Stretch
description: Standing on the footbar balls of feet, hands on the bar. Push the carriage out and lift it in with the abdominals.

name: Semi-Circle
description: Hands on the shoulder rests, feet on the footbar. Lower the hips, push out and roll the spine up through the circle.

name: Chest Expansion
description: Kneeling facing the straps. Pull the arms back, turn the head right and left, and return.

name: Thigh Stretch
description: Kneeling, holding the straps with arms straight. Hinge back in a straight line and return.

name: Arm Circles
description: Kneeling with back to the straps. Draw circles with the arms in front of the body, then reverse.

name: Snake
description: Twisted plank between the footbar and the shoulder rest. Snake the body out and return through a pike.

name: Twist
description: Side support with feet on the carriage. Push out, twist into a pike, and return.

name: Corkscrew
description: Holding the shoulder rests, legs overhead. Circle the legs down and around to each side.

name: Tic-Toc
description: Legs overhead holding the shoulder rests. Swing the legs side to side like a clock.

name: Balance Control Front
description: Plank on the frame, feet against the shoulder rests. Lift one leg as the carriage moves out and in.

name: Balance Control Back
description: Rolled over with feet on the frame. Lift one leg and press the carriage out.

name: Long Spine Massage
description: Feet in the straps, lift the legs overhead, open them, roll down through the spine and close.

name: Frog
description: Feet in straps, heels together and knees apart. Extend the legs out and bend back in.

name: Leg Circles
description: Feet in straps, legs straight. Circle the legs while keeping the pelvis stable. Reverse.

name: Knee Stretches - Round Back
description: Kneeling, hands on the footbar, back rounded. Push the carriage back and in with the legs.

name: Knee Stretches - Arched Back
description: Same as round back, with the back arched and chest lifted.

name: Knee Stretches - Knees Off
description: Knees hovering off the carriage, back rounded. Push the carriage back and in.

name: Running
description: Legs straight, balls of feet on the footbar. Alternate lowering one heel while bending the other knee.

name: Pelvic Lift
description: Feet on the footbar, hips lifted. Press the carriage out and in while holding the lift.

name: Side Splits
description: One foot on the platform, one on the carriage. Open the legs to the side and close.

name: Front Splits
description: Front foot on the platform, back foot against the shoulder rest. Slide into a split and return.

name: Russian Splits
description: Front foot on the carriage against the shoulder rest, back foot on the platform. Slide into a split and return.
